ios.desc:
Scrollie turns screen recordings, sequential screenshots, or even a single image into a clean, seamless long screenshot in seconds.

Whether you are saving chat history, social feeds, web pages, documents, or notes, Scrollie makes capture, stitching, editing, and export easier.

Key features:
• Turn screen recordings into long screenshots, with automatic stop after scrolling ends
• Stitch multiple screenshots into one seamless image, with more reliable long screenshot detection in manual stitching
• Open a single image directly in the editor for annotation, mosaic, watermark, and export
• Smart overlap detection and Smart Cleanup for more natural results and cleaner scrollbars
• Export to JPEG, PNG, HEIC, PDF, or sliced images for different layouts and platforms
• Slide to select multiple photos, and add more directly even under limited photo access
• Auto-save drafts with separate portrait and landscape recovery
• Use URL Scheme and Shortcuts to open the latest screenshot or screen recording
• Optimized for iPhone and iPad, with improved dark mode and clearer save, share, and permission feedback

Privacy first:
All processing is done on-device. Your screenshots and recordings are not uploaded to our servers.

Scroll, Stitch, Share.

In-App Purchases:
• Lifetime Pro Access
• Pro Monthly Subscription (1 month)
• Pro Annual Subscription (1 year)
Prices may vary by region and are shown in the app before purchase.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

quotes.text:
Built Scrollie, an iOS app for long screenshot workflows.

Main use case: convert recordings (or screenshot sequences) into one long image with less manual work.

Current focus:
- on-device stitching
- export editing (blur/mosaic, text, shapes, watermark)
- draft auto-save + resume
